typical_temperature_context: Hot pre-monsoon, warm humid monsoon with warm nights, mild days and cool nights in winter (zone-level means; extremes not given).
temperature_range: Seasonal means, NE Plain Zone of UP, 2004-2023 (Tmax/Tmin C): Mar-May 35.6/19.3; Jun-Sep 30.6/25.6; Oct-Nov 26.8/14.6; Dec-Feb 24.2/8.2.
rainfall_pattern: Normal rainfall by season (mm, rainy days): SW monsoon Jun-Sep 1182.1 (50); NE monsoon Oct-Dec 77.0 (2); winter Jan-Mar 46.1 (4); summer Apr-May 58.9 (5); annual 1364.1 (61). Normal SW-monsoon onset 3rd week of June; cessation 1st week of October.
general_growing_conditions: Rainfall is strongly concentrated in the SW monsoon period; the rest of the year is comparatively dry. Temperature, humidity and frost/heat frequency are not quantified in this record.
seasonal_gardening_implications: DERIVED (from sourced rainfall figures): rain-fed moisture is mostly available during the monsoon window; outside it, normal rainfall is low, so water supply for plants outside the monsoon depends on irrigation.
water_management_context: Plan notes no arsenic or fluoride problem in groundwater, low salinity, and calcium and iron problems in the majority of the area (as stated in the plan).
planting_window_context: Plan field-crop sowing windows (not garden-specific): kharif rainfed rice/maize/pigeonpea from the 4th week of June to the 1st week of July; rabi sowing from the 3rd week of October.

knowledge_text: Gorakhpur district (Uttar Pradesh, Middle Gangetic Plain) receives a normal annual rainfall of about 1364 mm, of which about 1182 mm falls in the June-September SW monsoon (onset about 3rd week of June, cessation about 1st week of October).
